info.name: Baserow API spec Dashboard widgets API
info.description:
For more information about our REST API, please visit this page.

For more information about our deprecation policy, please visit this page.

variable.description: (Required) Returns only the widgets of the dashboard related to the provided Id.

request.description: Lists all the widgets of the dashboard related to the provided parameter if the user has access to the related workspace.
